import java.util.*;

public class Main {
    static final int MAX_N = 10;
    static final int MAX_M = 25;
    static final int MAX_S = 1048580;
    static final int MOD = 1000000007;

    static int n;
    static int[][] prob = new int[MAX_N][MAX_N];
    static int[][] match_flag = new int[MAX_N][MAX_N];
    static int[] two_pow = new int[MAX_M];
    static int[] arr_a = new int[MAX_N];
    static int[] arr_b = new int[MAX_N];
    static int[] f_arr = new int[MAX_S];
    static int[] g_arr = new int[MAX_S];
    static int state_count;
    static int[] state_map = new int[70];
    static int[][] point_set = new int[MAX_M][MAX_N];
    static int[] state_stack = new int[MAX_M];
    static boolean[] visited_flag = new boolean[MAX_N];

    static int power_mod(int base, int exponent) {
        int result = 1;
        while (exponent != 0) {
            if ((exponent & 1) == 1) result = (int) ((long) result * base % MOD);
            base = (int) ((long) base * base % MOD);
            exponent >>= 1;
        }
        return result;
    }

    static void setup() {
        two_pow[0] = 1;
        for (int i = 1; i <= 20; ++i) two_pow[i] = two_pow[i - 1] << 1;
        Scanner scanner = new Scanner(System.in);
        n = scanner.nextInt();
        int inv_100 = power_mod(100, MOD - 2);
        for (int i = 1; i <= n; ++i) {
            for (int j = 1; j <= n; ++j) {
                prob[i][j] = scanner.nextInt();
                prob[i][j] = (int) ((long) prob[i][j] * inv_100 % MOD);
            }
        }
        while (n < 6) {
            prob[++n][n] = 1;
        }
    }

    static boolean find_matching(int pos) {
        if (pos > 3) return true;
        for (int candidate = 1; candidate <= 3; ++candidate) {
            if (!visited_flag[candidate] && match_flag[arr_a[pos]][arr_b[candidate]] == 1) {
                visited_flag[candidate] = true;
                if (find_matching(pos + 1)) {
                    visited_flag[candidate] = false;
                    return true;
                }
                visited_flag[candidate] = false;
            }
        }
        return false;
    }

    static void explore_second(int row, int col, int current_weight) {
        if (row > 3) {
            int mask = 0;
            for (int idx = 1; idx <= state_count; ++idx) {
                for (int k = 1; k <= 3; ++k) arr_b[k] = point_set[idx][k];
                if (find_matching(1)) mask |= two_pow[idx - 1];
            }
            f_arr[mask] = (f_arr[mask] + current_weight) % MOD;
            return;
        }
        match_flag[arr_a[row]][col] = 0;
        if (col == n) explore_second(row + 1, 1, (int) ((long) current_weight * (1 - prob[arr_a[row]][col] + MOD) % MOD));
        else explore_second(row, col + 1, (int) ((long) current_weight * (1 - prob[arr_a[row]][col] + MOD) % MOD));
        match_flag[arr_a[row]][col] = 1;
        if (col == n) explore_second(row + 1, 1, (int) ((long) current_weight * prob[arr_a[row]][col] % MOD));
        else explore_second(row, col + 1, (int) ((long) current_weight * prob[arr_a[row]][col] % MOD));
    }

    static void explore_first(int index, int count, int bitmask) {
        if (count == 3) {
            state_map[bitmask] = ++state_count;
            state_stack[state_count] = bitmask;
            for (int i = 1; i <= 3; ++i) point_set[state_count][i] = arr_a[i];
            return;
        }
        if (index > n) return;
        explore_first(index + 1, count, bitmask);
        arr_a[count + 1] = index;
        explore_first(index + 1, count + 1, bitmask | two_pow[index - 1]);
    }

    static void preprocess_g() {
        for (int i = 0; i < state_count; ++i)
            for (int j = 0; j < (1 << state_count); ++j)
                if ((j & two_pow[i]) != 0) g_arr[j] = (g_arr[j] + g_arr[j ^ two_pow[i]]) % MOD;
    }

    public static void main(String[] args) {
        setup();
        explore_first(1, 0, 0);
        arr_a[1] = 1; arr_a[2] = 2; arr_a[3] = 3;
        explore_second(1, 1, 1);
        for (int i = 0; i < (1 << state_count); ++i) {
            int new_mask = 0;
            for (int j = 1; j <= state_count; ++j) {
                int complement_id = state_map[(1 << n) - 1 - state_stack[j]];
                if ((i & two_pow[j - 1]) != 0) new_mask |= two_pow[complement_id - 1];
            }
            g_arr[new_mask] = f_arr[i];
            f_arr[i] = 0;
        }
        arr_a[1] = 4; arr_a[2] = 5; arr_a[3] = 6;
        explore_second(1, 1, 1);
        preprocess_g();
        int result = 0;
        for (int i = 0; i < (1 << state_count); ++i)
            result = (result + (int) ((long) f_arr[i] * g_arr[(1 << state_count) - 1 - i] % MOD)) % MOD;
        System.out.println((MOD + 1 - result) % MOD);
    }
}
